records.text: A source at Utah Valley University said a suspicious man seen apparently scouting campus on September 9 told campus security he was Senator Mike Lee's bodyguard checking the site for Lee's safety.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1CFDtD0IgEg)

appearances.snippet: And so they said, we're going to go up to this individual. And when that suspicious individual was approached, he told the campus security that he was Senator Mike Lee's bodyguard, scoping out the area to ensure that the senator was going to be safe ahead of the event. So they said, OK, that makes sense. We'll get we'll let you go.

verification.notes: The transcript establishes that Owens relayed this account from an anonymous UVU source. Current searches of UVU, Utah public-safety, law-enforcement, court, and news materials did not locate an incident report, security log, video, named witness, or official confirmation of the September 9 encounter or the purported bodyguard's statement. Because the claim rests on an anonymous source and no independent evidence was available, it is attempted/unverifiable rather than false.

records.text: Candace Owens said Senator Mike Lee had been scheduled to attend Charlie Kirk's September 10 event at Utah Valley University but canceled early that week because of National Defense Authorization Act votes in Washington.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now turning point USA, of course, was aware that Senator Lee (Mike Lee) was going to attend. But as the D.C. story goes, that week the senator had to cancel very early on in the week due to the National Defense Authorization Act.

verification.notes: Live research confirmed that the Senate was considering the FY2026 NDAA on September 10, 2025, and that Mike Lee was participating in Senate business that week. However, no public event listing, Lee-office statement, TPUSA record, or other authoritative source located in the search established that Lee had been scheduled for the UVU event or that he canceled specifically because of NDAA votes. The surrounding facts are plausible, but the key scheduling and cancellation assertions remain unverified.

records.text: Candace Owens said the purported bodyguard's explanation was false because Mike Lee's office had already canceled and Lee appeared not to have a security team.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The only thing is that that wasn't true. ... Like I said, by that time, the senator's office had already canceled their plans, and I have done some digging, and it also appears that Mike Lee is pretty down to earth. He doesn't actually have a security apparatus, a security team.

verification.notes: No authoritative public source located in current research established both that Lee's office had canceled before the alleged campus encounter and that Senator Lee had no security personnel or contractor who could have performed an advance check. Absence of a publicly described security team is not proof that none existed. The purported bodyguard's explanation therefore cannot be resolved as true or false from the available evidence.
